user.title: CKW login
user.description: Log in with your my.ckw.ch account. CKW will send you an SMS code in the next step.

code.title: SMS code
code.description: Enter the code from the most recent SMS. Tick "Send new code" and submit to get a new SMS (this makes all earlier codes invalid). Resent: {resent}.

reauth_confirm.title: CKW needs a new login
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login for {username} expired. Confirm your password; CKW will send a new SMS code.

history.title: Load history
history.description: How much data should the first import load? It runs in the background and the sensors stay unavailable until it is done. Durations are estimates. More can be loaded later with the action CKW: Import history.

error.invalid_auth: User name or password is wrong.
error.invalid_code: That SMS code was not accepted. Use the code from the most recent SMS.
error.code_required: Enter the SMS code, or tick "Send new code".
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach CKW. Try again later.
error.login_failed: The CKW login page looked different than expected. See the log.

abort.already_configured: This contract is already set up.
abort.no_contracts: No usable electricity contract found for this account.
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot reach CKW. Try again later.

import_history.name: Import history
import_history.description: Deletes the imported CKW statistics and imports everything again, starting at the given date. Runs in the background and can take several minutes. Use it to add older data than what was imported at setup.

start_date.name: Start date
start_date.description: First day to import. Default: the start of your supply contract.
